purpose: Short prospective identifiability pilot for posterior-conditioned cooperative commitment; not a formal performance experiment.

environment.public_joint_load_receipt: One-step delayed public Boolean that both actors requested LOAD. It never exposes either actor's level, critic state, tape, oracle action, or future task truth.

arms.ff_mappo: Matched feed-forward MAPPO with current legal observation only.
arms.recurrent_mappo: Matched recurrent MAPPO with legal observation-action-reward history.
arms.bc3_mappo: Recurrent MAPPO supplied with a posterior derived only from legal history and public receipts.
arms.shuffled_bc3_mappo: Same capacity and training path as BC3, with posterior values deterministically permuted across parallel environments.

required_information_checks: actor tensors contain no teammate level
posterior update uses no critic state
posterior update uses no evaluation tape or oracle label
public receipt is identical for both actors and records only a joint LOAD request

minimum: BC3 action selection changes after a legal failed joint-load receipt in the prespecified diagnostic slice
BC3 differs from recurrent MAPPO on at least one prespecified posterior-sensitive endpoint without using privileged input
posterior shuffling removes the corresponding behavior signature
identifiability_gate.stop_rule: If any minimum condition fails, do not extend budget, modify reward, replace seeds, or claim a posterior mechanism.

not_authorized: reward or task tuning after outcomes
